messages:
maya: Hey folks — noticed a p95 spike on shared-pool-3 starting ~08:12 UTC. Baseline ~90ms -> 480ms. Stack traces show a bunch of short-lived kernel flips and huge KV eviction bursts. Dashboard: https://rbw.in/mon/pool-shared-3 :eyes:
liam: Oof. Any specific tenant hotness?
anika: I kicked off pool-isolation-probe (v2) for 60s across all GPUs, per-tenant sampling. First pass shows a tenant with frequent long-seq requests (~>1024) causing kernel autoswitch on the same GPU, and that seems to thrash the KV slot set.
maya: I saw the same. KV eviction rate jumped from 0.8/s -> 6.3/s at the same time window. Also noticed batching heuristics toggled to eager mode for small reqs which increased scheduling churn.
duncan: Can you paste the probe output?
anika: Pasting condensed sampling output from the probe run:
```
# pool-isolation-probe --pool shared-pool-3 --duration 60s --per-tenant
tenant: content-search-svc
  reqs: 98
  avg_seq: 76
  long_seq_pct: 2.0
  kv_hit: 88%
  kernel_path: f16_fast
tenant: summarizer-async
  reqs: 12
  avg_seq: 980
  long_seq_pct: 74.2
  kv_hit: 11%
  kernel_path: f32_autoswitch -> int8_path (flip_count: 18)
tenant: chat-frontier
  reqs: 34
  avg_seq: 210
  kv_hit: 67%
  kernel_path: int8_path
global:
  kv_evictions_per_s: 6.3
  batch_fill_latency_ms: 14.2 -> 123.6 (during spike)
  kernel_switches/s: 4.7
```
liam: That summarizer-async tenant is our top suspect. Kernel flips + low kv_hit on long sequences = heavy memory pressure + longer per-token exec.
maya: Agreed. Also saw that during the window the runtime's kernel_selector heuristic bumped sequence threshold to trigger the f32 path for protection (quality), but this increased working set and caused evictions across tenants.
duncan: Any quick mitigation? Throttle or isolate tenant?
anika: I pushed ephemeral per-tenant qps cap for summarizer-async to 12 rps and enabled per-tenant KV pinning for its active slots (30s TTL) as a stop-gap. After the change p95 dropped back to ~110ms over 2 mins.
maya: Nice. Can we reproduce locally with a replay? If so we should add a guard in kernel_selector: refuse autoswitch if pool_eviction_rate > 1.5/s.
liam: I'll open a perf PR to add that guard and add telemetry for 'kernel_switch_reason' and per-tenant kv_pressure. Also adding an experiment flag to limit eager-batching when long_seq_pct > 30%.
duncan: I'll coordinate a canary to push the throttle + pin as a short-term policy for shared-pool-3 and schedule a rollout window. Ops runbook needs an entry: when kv_evictions_per_s > 2.0, apply per-tenant cap and KV pinning.
maya: Filing an incident ticket with the probe output and timeline. Followups: 1) revert kernel heuristic change if PR not green, 2) add automated detector for kernel_flip_rate spikes, 3) verify per-tenant limits don't regress throughput on dedicated pools.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1987 — "shared-pool-3 kv-eviction cascade from kernel-autoswitch". Assigned: duncan, liam. Priority: P2.
liam: I'll post the PR link once ready and attach perf regression graphs. Thanks for quick triage everyone :thumbsup:
maya: Good catch all — keep updates here.
